title: craspedia minor
intro: Craspedia minor, commonly known as Billy buttons or Green Billy buttons, is a flowering plant species native to New South Wales and Queensland in Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Craspedia minor may include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing and immune system function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
